g.title: HR_ABSENCEPLAN
g.text: Absence Plan - Contains the absence plans.
Indicates if daily planning is allowed.
Indicates if the Absence is accruable.
Indicates the default reason for absence requests created in this plan.
The set of people eligible to be enrolled in this plan.
Indicates the policy of the remaining entitlement.
The maximum allowed to carry over from previous accrual.
Indicates the expiration period day for the carry over.
Indicates the expiration carry over month.
The maximum entitlement you can get including any carry over and adjustments.
Tick this flag to allow a negative remaining entitlement at the end of the period.

With this flag active it's possible to distinguish the entitlement earned at a given date (normally imported from a Payroll system) from the entitlement the employee will earn at the end of the accrual period.
Indicates if a negative projected remaining is allowed.
This field includes all options to calculate the taken time units when saving an absence request.
Indicates if, when an absence is booked, it is necessary to specify the return to work date.
